obstetricBands.title: Swedish obstetric NEWS2 chart by Hein, Lindroos and Åmark, reproduced in the 2025 SFOG course
obstetricBands.scope: Resolve the four overlapping endpoints in the 2025 WEST ONEWS2 table. WEST defines pathway eligibility and colour thresholds.

message.en: Enter a supporting finding or measurement, or choose a WEST color to save.
message.sv: Ange fynd eller mätvärden som ger en triagefärg eller välj en WEST-färg för att spara.

result.explicitNoWarningCriteria: An explicit entry-wide assessment or a category-specific No criteria met selection for every documented category.

optionSemantics.paediatricRows: retain source rows, omit from adult choices
optionSemantics.emptyCategory: Keep an unanswered category in the picker only. Document a category when it has a selected finding or its explicit No criteria met option.
optionSemantics.greenCriterion: also document absence of higher warning criteria before showing calculated green

diastolic.nonNumericValue: Palpated pressure does not supply a numeric diastolic component.

extraction_notes.en: Clinical categories and care needs/processes come from pages 10–48. NEWS2, ONEWS2, GCS, mNIHSS, monitoring, orders, and SBAR are supporting materials and are not separate clinical categories.
extraction_notes.sv: Kliniska kategorier och behov/processer från sidorna 10–48. NEWS2, ONEWS2, GCS, mNIHSS, övervakning, ordinationer och SBAR är stödmaterial och ingår inte som egna kliniska kategorier.

extraction_notes.en: The category pages are the source for criteria. The overviews on pages 3–5 sometimes differ from the category pages. Differences are retained unless a resolution is recorded. Trauma alert colors come from page 3.
extraction_notes.sv: Kategorisidorna används som källa för kriterier. Översiktssidorna 3–5 upprepar och avviker ibland från kategorisidorna; ingen tyst harmonisering har gjorts. Traumalarmsfärger hämtas från sida 3.

extraction_notes.en: Line breaks and extra spaces have been normalized. Clinical conditions and thresholds in the findings have not been converted into automated decision rules.
extraction_notes.sv: Radbrytningar och extra blanksteg har normaliserats. Kliniska villkor och tröskelvärden har inte tolkats om till maskinella beslutsregler.

extraction_notes.en: An empty criteria list means that the category has no color-coded criteria of its own or that its criteria appear in subcategories.
extraction_notes.sv: Tom criteria-lista betyder att inga egna färgsatta kriterier anges, eller att kriterierna ligger i subcategories.

notes.en: The green criteria are headed GREEN 07–16. The separate referral table for antenatal care, primary care, and outpatient gynecology on page 22 has no explicit triage color and is excluded from the color-coded criteria.
notes.sv: Gröna kriterier har rubriken GRÖN 07-16. Den separata hänvisningstabellen MVC/VC/ÖV-gyn på sida 22 saknar uttrycklig triagefärg och ingår inte som färgsatta kriterier.

notes.en: Three color rows refer postoperative infection to the infection category. These are cross-references and do not assign all three colors to postoperative infection.
notes.sv: Post-op infektion hänvisar till infektion i tre färgrader; dessa är korshänvisningar och innebär inte att all postoperativ infektion har samtliga tre färger.

notes.en: In the original, page 22 is labeled 1/2 although it is the continuation page.
notes.sv: Sida 22 är rubricerad 1/2 i originalet trots att den är fortsättningssidan.

**.en: The vaginal cuff is sutured during hysterectomy. It can rupture spontaneously or after vaginal penetration. Bleeding and pain are uncommon, but assessment is needed because of the risk of bowel prolapse or infection.
**.sv: Vid hysterektomi sutureras vaginaltoppen. Kan rupturera t.ex. vid penetration av slidan eller spontant. Ger sällan blödning/smärta men behöver bedömas pga risk för tarmprolaps/infektion.

***.en: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) can develop after starting IVF treatment, before or after embryo transfer. See the Barium guideline on OHSS.
***.sv: OHSS Ovariellt hyperstimuleringssyndrom uppstår i samband med inledd IVF-beh före eller efter embryoöverföring. Se bariumrutin OHSS.

notes.en: Page 37 clarifies the warning signs. The explanations are retained separately.
notes.sv: Sida 37 förtydligar varningssymtomen; definitionerna bevaras separat.

text.en: Suicide attempt. Assess the level of observation required and assess using NEWS2.
text.sv: Suicidförsök Bedöm tillsynsgrad! Bedöm enligt NEWS2.

text.en: Self-harm with a strong wish to die now, or a threat of a suicide attempt in progress. Inform the nurse in charge immediately. Assess the level of observation required. Do not leave the patient alone. Are means of suicide available?
text.sv: Självskada med uttalad suicidönskan Här och nu perspektiv. Hot om pågående suicidförsök. Informera omedelbart ledningssjuksköterska. Bedöm tillsynsgrad! Lämna inte patienten ensam. Finns självmordsredskap tillgängligt?

text.en: Self-harm. The patient intentionally injures themselves in the emergency department.
text.sv: Självskada Patient utsätter avsiktligt sin kropp för skada på akutmottagning

text.en: Ongoing violence. The patient attacks people or objects, for example by kicking, hitting, throwing or knocking things down, or smashing windows. Contact a physician immediately. Consider compulsory measures.
text.sv: Pågående våld Attackerar person eller föremål. Sparka, slå, kasta saker, slå ner saker eller krossa fönster Direkt kontakt med läkare. Överväg tvångsåtgärder

text.en: Physically threatening behavior. Clear intent to threaten another person physically, for example through an aggressive stance, grabbing their clothes, or raising a hand threateningly. Contact a physician. Offer sedative medication and assess the level of observation required.
text.sv: Fysisk hotfull En tydlig avsikt att kroppsligen hota en annan person, tex en aggressiv kroppshållning, ta tag i någon annan persons kläder, hotande höja handen. Kontakt med läkare. Erbjud lugnande läkemedel. Bedöm tillsynsgrad.

text.en: Verbally threatening behavior. An outburst that goes beyond raising the voice and is intended to humiliate or frighten another person. Offer sedative medication and assess the level of observation required.
text.sv: Verbalt hotfull Ett verbalt utbrott som mer än att höja rösten och har för avsikt att förödmjuka eller skrämma annan person Erbjud lugnande läkemedel. Bedöm tillsynsgrad

text.en: Delirium tremens is a serious medical condition requiring treatment. Contact a physician immediately if suspected. Onset is usually 2–4 days after stopping alcohol. Signs include picking at objects, delusions, marked agitation, confusion, and visual or auditory hallucinations. Assess using NEWS2. Elevated pulse, blood pressure, and temperature are common.
text.sv: Delirium tremens DT är ett allvarligt medicinsk tillstånd och kräver behandling! Direkt kontakt med läkare vid misstanke Uppstår oftast 2-4 dygn efter avbrutet drickande. Symtom: plockighet, vanföreställningar, stark oro, konfusion samt syn- och hörselhallucinos. Bedöm enligt NEWS2. Förhöjd puls, förhöjt blodtryck samt temperaturstegring är vanligt.

text.en: Marked withdrawal symptoms with physical signs and risk of seizures and delirium tremens. Contact a physician. Use a single room, offer sedative medication, and assess the level of observation required.
text.sv: Påtagliga abstinenssymtom med somatisk påverkan Risk för EP och DT (somatisk påverkan) Kontakt med läkare. Eget rum. Erbjud lugnande läkemedel. Bedöm tillsynsgrad.

text.en: New behavioral disturbance. Hallucinations and delusions may be new or reflect worsening psychosis. Confusion develops over hours to days. Mania may present with marked overactivity, pressured speech, and disinhibition. Other signs include marked anxiety, emotional lability, inhibition, or dissociation.
text.sv: Nytillkommet avvikande beteende Hallucinationer:Nytillkomna eller försämring i befintlig psykossjukdom Vanföreställningar - Nytillkomna eller försämring i befintlig psykossjukdom Konfusion – Har ett snabbt insjuknande, timmar till dagar. Mani – Kraftig uppvarvning, forcerat talflöde, gränslös Påtagligt oroligt beteende Påtaglig affektlabilitet Påtagliga hämningar Dissociation

clarification.en: A level 2 alert is triggered when the mechanism suggests that an unprotected patient sustained high-energy trauma and serious injury is possible despite stable vital signs.

notes.en: National trauma alert criteria apply when the mechanism of injury affects multiple organ systems. Levels 1 and 2 are red and level 3 is yellow, as shown on page 3.

footnote.en: *Consider direct transport in VGR to RTC Sahlgrenska SU/S or DBUS SU if the patient’s physiology and the transport distance permit. Have a low threshold for upgrading the alert if a cautionary feature is present.
footnote.sv: *Överväg att köra patienter i VGR direkt till RTC Sahlgrenska SU/S eller DBUS SU om fysiologi och transportsträcka tillåter. Var frikostig med uppgradering av larm vid kriterium för observandum.

definition.en: Age ≥75 years plus a modified FRESH score ≥2 defines frailty. Living in residential care scores 2 points. Reduced endurance, general tiredness or reduced energy for <2 months, frequent falls or fear of falling, and needing help with shopping each score 1 point. Assign at least yellow priority and see the patient first within their color group.

conflicts.finding: Four ONEWS2 cells overlap at RR 10, systolic BP 80, diastolic BP 90 and pulse 60.
conflicts.handling: Apply the contemporaneous Swedish obstetric NEWS2 chart at the four overlapping endpoints. RR 10 scores 0, systolic BP 80 scores 2, diastolic BP 90 scores 1 and pulse 60 scores 0.

conflicts.finding: Category uses potassium ≥6.0 with ECG changes. Overview uses >6.0.
conflicts.handling: Use the inclusive category threshold. Potassium exactly 6.0 with ECG changes qualifies for the red finding.

conflicts.finding: Overview includes acute dizziness at 4.5–24 hours or unknown onset and mNIHSS ≥2 in red. The category and extract name suspected stroke in that row.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied Östra neurology category rows and their onset and mNIHSS qualifiers. An overview-only dizziness combination does not create a selectable finding.

conflicts.finding: Östra supplies six gynaecology subcategories, including time-limited green criteria. SkaS has a different category structure. In the non-pregnant bleeding subgroup the supplied JSON gives heavy vaginal bleeding yellow; the SkaS female genital category gives it orange. The supplied bleeding category also gives it orange.
conflicts.handling: Assign the identical heavy vaginal bleeding criterion orange in both adult pickers. The pregnancy-specific heavy bleeding criterion remains red. Preserve the original yellow on the non-pregnant source row. Apply 07:00 inclusive to 16:00 exclusive at local measurement time to timed green rows.

conflicts.finding: SkaS lists ongoing vomiting before week 18 as yellow here. Östra includes a separate early-pregnancy nausea and vomiting pathway.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied early-pregnancy nausea and vomiting pathway with its own criteria. The SkaS overview adds no separate finding.

conflicts.finding: Overview qualifies hanging/strangulation by visible or audible injury; the category lists it without that qualifier.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied red hanging or strangulation criterion. Visible or audible injury is not an additional selection condition.

conflicts.finding: The extract describes withdrawal with risk of both seizure and delirium tremens, while the SkaS category says either.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied Östra orange criterion for somatically affected withdrawal with risk of both seizure and delirium tremens.

conflicts.finding: The SkaS overview includes gurgling with foaming breathing; the category describes foaming breathing.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied red dyspnoea with foaming breathing criterion. Gurgling is not an additional selection condition.

conflicts.finding: The compact SkaS table omits saturation ≥93% on air from Scale 2. The RCP chart explicitly assigns 0.
conflicts.handling: Score saturation of 93% or above on room air as zero on prescribed Scale 2. Use the separate supplemental-oxygen branch when oxygen is administered.

conflicts.finding: SkaS prohibits clinical down-prioritisation from red or orange.
conflicts.handling: A clinician may select any of the four colours. That single effective colour takes precedence. Store the calculated result and provenance separately.

conflicts.finding: Overview describes ingestion of a battery or magnet. The category and extract specify a button battery or at least two magnets.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied orange criterion for a button battery or at least two magnets.

conflicts.finding: The overview includes symptomatic smoke inhalation (orange), finger or toe dislocation (yellow), and newly impaired or worsened outwardly aggressive behaviour with inability to care for oneself (yellow). These are not standalone criteria in the extract under those labels.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied category inventory. Symptomatic smoke inhalation, finger or toe dislocation and the overview-only behavioural description are not additional standalone options.

conflicts.finding: SkaS specifies more than 1,000 V or lightning. The extract refers to high voltage or lightning without the number.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied red high-voltage or lightning criterion. The clinician selects this finding.

conflicts.finding: The supplied joint criterion says interarticular; the SkaS category describes intra-articular swelling.
conflicts.handling: Use the supplied Östra joint criterion and wording. A clinician selecting it records yellow.
